status_sections.Summary: Red: Unagi 21.0.2 is the worst release RAG, with 1 open blocker and 80.0% done. The single biggest risk is the backlog of 26 open blockers and criticals, including 22 escalations and 55 items with no assignee. Over the last 30 days, 34 issues were opened and 12 were resolved, for a net increase of 22; total open is 179.
status_sections.Risks & slips:
- SPEC-5676 is the open blocker on Unagi 21.0.2; release RAG is Red.
- SPEC-5625, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, SPEC-5713, SPEC-5734, SPEC-5740, SPEC-5741, and SPEC-5747 are open blockers with no assignee.
- SPEC-4693, SPEC-4963, SPEC-5487, SPEC-5444, SPEC-5468, SPEC-5483, and SPEC-5561 are long-running blockers and remain on the agenda.
- SPEC-5375 is the open critical item and is also escalated.
- Hygiene remains weak: 173 issues have no fix version, 113 have no component, 55 have no assignee, and 147 are stale.
status_sections.Asks / decisions needed:
- Assign owners to the open blocker items with no assignee: SPEC-5625, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, SPEC-5713, SPEC-5734, SPEC-5740, SPEC-5741, and SPEC-5747.
- Confirm whether SPEC-5676 is the release blocker for Unagi 21.0.2 and what the release decision is.
- Decide how to handle the open critical SPEC-5375.
- Confirm priority for the long-running blockers on the agenda: SPEC-4693, SPEC-4963, SPEC-5487, SPEC-5444, SPEC-5468, SPEC-5483, and SPEC-5561.
status_sections.Next steps:
- Triage the 22 escalations and update status on each key.
- Reduce the open blocker/critical set from 26 by closing or reclassifying items where appropriate.
- Assign owners to the 55 unassigned issues.
- Clean up hygiene fields for issues missing fix version, component, or assignee.
- Review the 147 stale issues and refresh status where needed.
